questions.q: Why do sales organizations often need Enterprise Territory Management in addition to role hierarchy?
options: Territory assignments represent a second, independently-changing axis of access (e.g., geography) that would require constantly re-parenting roles if modeled through role hierarchy alone
Role hierarchy cannot grant Read access under any circumstances
Territory Management replaces the need for organization-wide defaults entirely
Role hierarchy only works for custom objects, not standard objects like Account
questions.explain: Territories give sales orgs an independent access axis that can be reshaped (e.g., quarterly) without touching the role hierarchy used for everything else, avoiding constant role re-parenting and recalculation.

questions.q: What does a Territory Type represent in Enterprise Territory Management?
options: The access level (Read/Edit) a territory grants on Accounts
The specific hierarchy of territories inside one model
A category that groups territories sharing a common trait, carrying a priority used for overlapping access paths
A one-time setting that enables the whole feature org-wide
questions.explain: Territory Type is the category layer — every individual territory belongs to exactly one type, and the type's priority matters when a record is reachable through more than one territory path.

questions.q: How many Territory Models can be in the Active state in an org at one time?
options: As many as needed, one per business unit
Unlimited, but only the first one created can ever be reactivated
Zero; models are only used for planning and never activated
Exactly one — other models can exist but must be in Planning or Archived state
questions.explain: Only one Territory Model can be Active org-wide at a time, though an org can hold multiple inactive/planning models simultaneously for comparison before committing.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a Territory Model's Planning state?
options: It permanently disables sharing recalculation for that model
It lets an admin fully build and preview a hierarchy's assignments before the expensive step of activating it in production
It is a read-only historical record of a model that was previously active
It automatically limits the model to 10 territories instead of 1,000
questions.explain: Planning lets an admin preview exactly what access a new hierarchy would produce before committing, since unwinding a wrong hierarchy in production (reassigning accounts, recalculating sharing) is expensive.

questions.q: What operational event does activating a new Territory Model trigger?
options: A permanent increase to the 1,000-territories-per-model ceiling
An automatic rollback of the previously active model's data
A sharing recalculation job across every account and its related records affected by the new model
A one-time email notification to all territory members, with no other system impact
questions.explain: Activating a model (or reassigning large numbers of accounts between territories) triggers a sharing recalculation across every affected account and related record — a significant operation, not a routine save.
